Bug_Details:
Comparing protobuf fields of type String using reference equality Comparing strings with == is almost always an error, but it is an error 100% of
the time when one of the strings is a protobuf field. Additionally, protobuf
fields cannot be null, so Object.equals(Object) is always more correct.
Bug_Explanation: The bug occurs when comparing strings using '==', which checks for reference equality rather than content equality. This is especially erroneous when dealing with protobuf fields, as protobuf ensures strings are non-null and should be checked with Object.equals(Object).
Trigger_Explanation: The test case 'testShowBugWithIdenticalContentStrings' triggers the bug by using 'showBug' method with two strings having the same content but different references. The method incorrectly uses '==' for string comparison, failing to recognize strings with identical content but different references as equal.
